name: Symbiote
descriptionText: Symbiote Style is focused on supporting your allies through mutual benefits.

abilities.name: Symbiote Style
abilities.rulesText:
During your turn, you can use Leech for free once, as if you have used a "3", if you are Attached to an ally.
Teleportation no longer breaks your Attachment to allies.

actions.name: I know your pain
actions.rulesText:
Discard an equal amount of Status Tokens of the same type from the Attached ally.
Usable once per turn.

actions.name: Prosper Together
actions.rulesText:
You and Attached ally gain 1 Power Token
5+: Both of you also gain a 3-Point Shield
10+ Your ally, on their next turn, also add a D8 to their Action Pool
